description: Create a menu that adapts to mobile screens.
definition: A responsive navigation bar keeps important links usable at different widths.
tip: flex-wrap lets links flow onto another line.
caution: This example wraps; it is not a hamburger menu.
exercise: Try three links at a narrow width.
title: Responsive Navbar with CSS Flexbox: Make Links Wrap
shortTitle:
A menu that
fits your screen
idea: Keep every link visible and usable.
closing: Can you still use every link?
